section: AVI-SPL Professional Services: design and planning, implementation support, end-user training and video production
body:
AVI-SPL Professional Services position AVI-SPL as an advisor to the customer's IT team across a collaboration project. The stated scope runs from assessment, design, program management, preparation and installation to post-install support and end-user training.

**What to know**

- **Design and Planning**: AVI-SPL's engineering expertise and solutions architects design and plan the customer's collaboration technology solutions and infrastructure. AVI-SPL provides discovery, assessment and roadmap development.
- **Implementation Support**: AVI-SPL's certified technicians help ensure smooth AV integration and UC system installation. Its experts guide pre-implementation planning, deal with potential roadblocks and make sure the technology works as expected.
- **End-user Technology Training Services**: expertise and programs that bring teams up to speed on the organization's latest AV and UC technology, so that all users can work the workplace tech efficiently.
- **Video production and streaming**: content is created with AV technology and equipment of broadcast quality. The page suggests broadcast video as a way to raise employee retention, sales and brand value.

**When to use this**

For customers asking what help AVI-SPL gives an IT team before, during and after an installation, including planning, installation support and training users on new room technology.

**Not stated in this source**: timelines, deliverables in detail, which certifications the technicians hold, training formats and prices.
